The MBCZ16 Bus bar protection is a Modular, solid state, low impedance 
 blast differential based on the circulating current principle, dual 
 cratered of protection, provides continuous supervision of CT secondary 
 circuits and constant monitoring of vital circuits extremely stable up to 
 the max switch gear.

 El Badrawy at 25 February 2003, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng.Adel 
 Abdel Qader 
 El Nagar, accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud Saker, 
 and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of TAlkha PS.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Safety 
 fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Outage arrangement is required.

Switches off DC supply before inserting or with drawing any 
 card from the relay .

Before with drawing MBCZ 16 modules from its case fit CT 
 shorting to test bluge before inserted into test block.
Test Module MBCZ 18 GEC .
Alarm Module MBCZ 17 GEC.
Bus wire Access MBCZ 19 GEC.
Connection of test unit.

Turn the key switch on the alarm unit to the PROTECTION 
 OUT position.

The test unit can be used to check the zone measuring 
 units. To do this the covers must be removed from the test unit and the 
 zone unit to be checked .

The screened test lead should be plugged into the test 
 unit using the end of the lead with the 3.5 mm jack plug. The 2mm plug 
 on the other end of the test lead is then plugged into the test input on 
 the phase of the zone to be tested.

It is assumed for these tests that the bus bar is dead 
 Note : Assume a matching ratio of 1.0 when testing units by this method.

Set the selector switch on the front of the test unit to 
 INJECTXI.
Set the digital current switch to 00.

Press the button marked INJECT and whilst holding it down 
 increase the current unit the meter reads a current just below the setting 
 of the supervision relay.

Then increase slowly until the supervision operates to 
 indicate a CT fault . There is a fixed fifteen second delay built into 
 this circuit .

The minimum operating current can then be read from the 
 meter as a direct percentage of rated current .

For this test no bias will be produced and hence the 
 setting will be somewhat less than the marked value . The effective 
 setting will be in the order of 90% of the marked values.
Set the MAN / AUTO switch to MAN.

Set the CURRENT TO 80 % of the marked value of the 
 selected setting and the relay should not indicate a trip. Increase the 
 current to the marked setting value and the protection should operate .

There should be a TRIP indication on the element being 
 tested and a PROT. OPERATED indication on the alarm unit. The latter has a 
 15 second delay.

Release the injection button and reset the indications. 
 Check that when the inject button is now depressed the trip is 
 instantaneous and that when the current I injected for five seconds no 
 PROTN FAIL indication comes up .

Repeat (14) on the other two phases and then on each 
 other zone in turn .
Write the value of test in the test sheet.

Decrease the value of injection current to become zero ( 
 0.0 ) .

Turn the key switch ( MAN / AUTO ) on position ( AUTO ) as 
 before .
Reset all signals which occurred during the test .

Insert the coupling test ( test lead ) between the unit 
 test and measure test .
Set the all cover of units which inserted .

Set the switch in alarm unit ( MBCZ 17 ) on position ( 
 PROT . IN ) .
